label: Only the actual GOD_4 could meet the divine description at an accessible world
paraphrase: Open bridge on the selected profile and world w: for every world v accessible from w and every candidate y, if y satisfies the God-description GodAt at v and exists at v, then y is actually GOD_4 (sigma.IsGod y). The God-description cannot be satisfied, at an accessible world, by a being other than the actual God. It does not say that the actual God exists at v or satisfies the description there.
